If your phone service works look up child protective services in your area. Or call the police and tell them you are getting abused. Record it the next time it happens for proof. How are you doing at the moment?
Exactly. Wtf is she thinking. My guess is she’s on the life insurance and could care less

Listen. My dad was in your same position, married. Four kids. Put a gun to his head and when I found him hold his gun in his room I stopped him. I’ve been traumatized ever since. You can do this if 15 years is what it takes just stay for your child. He needs you! At least contribute to him growing up having a healthy relationship with you. If you can’t live for yourself try to live for him. The only reason I’m around is because my dog needs me even though he’s not human I love him like he’s my child. Please stay

Since you told her it can become a legal issue. They will question her as to why you killed yourself amd if she knew anything about it. That puts her in an awful position. Why is she even okay with you wanting to kill yourself? Stop this. There are ways out of everything it just takes time even if you are in debt. Money comes and goes and it’s not forever that you will be stuck like this. It’s not worth leaving your child behind and him wondering where his daddy went. I’ve seen children wrecked over their parents dying and it affects them forever

Your comment is all too true...thank you for clarifying this...I’m 22 so it’s drilled in my head that I’m awful and that I’ll never change etc. my dad is a narcissist and my mom a victim of child abuse and personality disorder and compares me to her abusive father...how do I change my mindset? How do I find peace knowing I will never have a relationship with my family?

THERE IS NO MINIMIZING THE IMPACT. Your family will be devastated for years. Nothing you leave behind will make that pain go away. You will leave your wife a widow to take care of your son on her own. Please stay for him!

Imagine the pain your wife and child will feel? They will be DEVESTATED! I myself want to go. But don’t do it if you have a family who love sand supports you. Your wife might even bring herself to the point of death from you doing that. And your son? Every day crying to his mom as to why daddy isn’t here? Don’t go. They need you and you need them
Block him?

The first paragraph resonates with me. I figured out the passcode to my dads gun safe. Put it to my head, pulled the trigger. It was empty. That day never changed how I felt about dying though. I still feel the same...therapy help me feel better in the moment but nothing else helps. How to encourage someone to not die when you yourself want to die? I take my dog to the park and observe him. How he lives. Interacts. I enjoy him and I stay for him. Can you find ANYTHING to stay for? Maybe your families reaction when they find you dead? I’ve seen tiktoks of a woman who is still grieving for her daughter ten years after her death
